findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "horse_changes" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Return material Horse Truth change events for one horse." → after: "PAID: US$0.02 per successful autonomous x402 call, or 1 Horse Truth direct credit. Return material Horse Truth change events for one horse."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
